patterns_found.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
patterns_found.evidence: Three distinct swing lows visible: left shoulder near 1775-1800, head at 1725, right shoulder forming near 1775-1800. Neckline resistance around 1800-1825 has been approached and price is trading above it at 1830.21.

patterns_found.name: Bullish Flag
patterns_found.evidence: Strong impulsive upward move from approximately 1725 to 1840 followed by tight sideways consolidation near current price 1830.21.

patterns_found.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
patterns_found.evidence: Market structure shifted from bearish sequence of lower highs and lower lows to bullish structure after holding the 1725 low and establishing higher highs and higher lows.

vlm_analysis.visual_evidence: Price formed a significant low near 1725, rallied to test 1825 resistance, pulled back to form a right shoulder around 1775-1800, and is currently trading above the neckline area near 1830 with bullish momentum.
